ns2:section.sectionText: Conceiving, designing, performing, analyzing data and reporting the results of experiments in HCI contexts and evaluating interactive technologies in engineering. Topics include defining the research question, selecting experimental objects, tasks, and participants, the ethical protection of subjects, selecting an experimental design, threats to validity, the collection and analysis of both qualitative and quantitative data, and reporting experimental research in publications. Prerequisite CS 225. For up-to-date information about CS course restrictions, please see the following link: http://go.cs.illinois.edu/csregister
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC, MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC, or NDEG:Computer Science Onl-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Not intended for First Time Freshman students.
